weights.note: Where the host's model file comes from. Either download the 4-bit GGUF from a community conversion (the repository and file name are the expected ones and are UNVERIFIED: confirm them on the Hugging Face page and take the exact file name), or make it with llama.cpp (convert_hf_to_gguf.py, then llama-quantize) from the pinned revision in self_made_from. The file lives outside the repository, in the weights folder (MYAPP_MODELS_DIR, default ~/myapp-models), at `path`. After the download run `python -m training.common.weights FILE` and write the hash into `sha256`; `python -m training.common.weights --check teacher` verifies it later. The same block format serves the investigator's pre-made GGUF (investigator/config/candidates.json).
